Use case: illustration-story. Create exactly one finished Japanese basketball article thumbnail, landscape aspect ratio approximately 16:9, ideally 1600 x 900 or larger, PNG.

Editorial source is a fixed manuscript dated 2026-11-08. All listed games are PRE-GAME as of 11/08 00:36 JST; same-day stats are awaiting official confirmation. There is NO named featured player and no confirmed ranking or performance. The thumbnail must say only the exact copy below. Do not imply the illustrated player appeared, scored, was selected in a best five, or won. This is a generic illustrative basketball action, NOT a recreation of any actual game.

Art direction: use the approved black-and-lime ink illustration reference seen in this conversation (black #151A18, vivid lime #CCF43B, warm ivory Japanese heavy lettering, hand-cut bold brush marks and scratchy ink hatching). Do not copy its player, names, 38 points, scores, or date. Keep elements few, strong graphic hierarchy and generous space. Avoid photography, photorealism, realistic photographic compositing, shiny 3D, glossy anime.

Subject: ONE REAL player, Ryusei Miyamoto (宮本龍世), chosen randomly from Tokyo Hachioji Bee Trains' current official roster. His official club portrait has just been viewed in this conversation: a young Japanese man with thick straight black hair, a rounded natural forward fringe that slightly sweeps sideways over the forehead, dark almond-shaped eyes, natural straight eyebrows, oval face with fairly narrow lower jaw, straight moderately broad nose, full lips, small natural cheek moles, completely clean shaven. Match this specific real face in ink illustration, not a generic invented athlete. Compact athletic guard build. Use the official photo solely as an identity reference, never paste or reproduce the photo.
Draw him occupying the LEFT 45 percent of the canvas, three-quarter frontal face clearly visible, leaning into a dynamic low crossover drive. Torso tilts diagonally, knees bent, one hand naturally above / contacting a single orange basketball at hip-to-knee level, the other arm bent for balance. Show coherent anatomy, exactly two arms and two hands, natural five-finger hand structure where visible. Ball is a prop belonging to the player. Use thigh-up action framing with head, both hands and ball entirely inside canvas and away from type. Blank ivory-and-black basketball jersey with simple lime piping, no numbers, names, crests, team or league logos, sponsors, or manufacturer marks. NO other people or silhouetted invented defenders. Small abstract brush swooshes imply motion without an identifiable venue, hoop, opponent, score clock, or actual match.

Layout: player LEFT; large clean typography RIGHT about 52 percent; left and right content do not overlap. Black field, one lime rising brush slash BEHIND the player, restrained flecks. Keep all letters and face well inside 5 percent edge safe margins. Lower annotation strip remains clean and legible.

Exact visible text, all correctly spelled and fully readable:
Small brand at upper right: 「バスケまとめ」
Huge lime date on the right: 「11/08」
Huge warm ivory headline below date on the right, kept as one line: 「試合予定」
Medium-small clear supporting line under headline: 「当日成績は確定待ち」
Smaller timing qualifier directly below that: 「11/08 00:36 JST時点」
Bottom left or bottom center on dark background, clearly legible: 「イラスト（AI生成）」 and 「イメージ」
Render ONLY these seven strings, without Japanese quotation marks. Do not put the player's name, team name, a statistical ranking, TOP3, BEST5, score, point total, or any additional claims on the artwork.
Typography: very bold Japanese gothic with controlled ink texture on large headline, crisp smaller lines. This must be a polished publishable editorial thumbnail, with accurate Japanese text, faithful recognizable drawn likeness, and strong movement.
